limitations: Mapped positions are not surveyed. Rio Rancho points are possible rotating deployments; county source freshness remains its original verification date when fetches fail.

points.decision: Desk reconciliation 2026-09-14: OSM mapped point matches its named local road and cross street. Rio Rancho describes ten rotating local-road units but does not publish their exact live positions. This is a community-mapped possible deployment site, not an agency-confirmed current location or a permanent camera. OSM ref supplies an approach where explicit; direction=forward is not interpreted as a bearing.
